newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares dive 12.5 pct in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares dive 12.5 pct in afternoon.

text.p: Turkish shares extended sharp morning losses in early afternoon trade on Tuesday as heavy selling continued amid political concerns and higher-than expected February inflation, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 sank 190 points, or 12.48 percent to 1,332 in the first 12 minutes of the second session. It was down nine percent at 1,385 at midday.
